_help.matches: Manual results that replace/add to the live feed. Each entry: { "stage": "GROUP|R32|R16|QF|SF|THIRD|FINAL", "home": "BRA", "away": "MAR", "homeScore": 2, "awayScore": 1, "status": "FINISHED", "winner": "BRA" }. 'winner' is only needed for knockout games decided on penalties. Matched against the feed by stage+teams.
_help.groupOrder: Force final group standings if the auto-computed tiebreak ever differs from FIFA's official one, e.g. { "A": ["MEX", "KOR", "RSA", "CZE"] }
